gate_results.rationale: Phase is opportunity. Applying the IT decision policy to REVIEW_FACTS_IT: catalog_status is 'non_standard' with waiver_present false, so IT-CATALOG-001 (high, REWORK, SUBMIT_TECHNOLOGY_WAIVER) applies. duplicate_capability is true with existing_alternative 'shared_api_platform', so IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK, ASSESS_EXISTING_CAPABILITY) applies. Other predicates do not fire: license_compliant true; cmdb_record_present true; run_owner_present true; technology_eol_months 18 (>=12); capacity_headroom_pct 45 and phase not build_acceptance/deployment_closure; change_record_status 'draft' but phase is not deployment_closure. Highest disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required.

Applied the DGF-decision-v8 architecture policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (version 1, age 0 days). Firing predicates: (1) data_owner_present = false → ARCH-DATA-001 (high, REWORK, ASSIGN_DATA_OWNER, Data Architect); corroborated by non-authoritative DATA_MODEL which shows "data_owner": null for a Confidential data model. (2) reversibility_status = "missing" → ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, Enterprise Architect); corroborated by LLD field "Reversibility | missing". Non-firing predicates: ip_overlap = false (ARCH-IP-001 not applicable); api_gateway_required = true and api_gateway_present = true, consistent with LLD ("API gateway required | True", "API gateway present | True"), so ARCH-API-001 does not fire; measured_latency_ms 15 <= latency_target_ms 500, so ARCH-PERF-001 does not fire; business_criticality is High but architecture_profile multi_az = true and multi_region = true (HLD shows Multi-AZ and a North Europe WARM STANDBY region), so ARCH-HA-001 does not fire. Highest-priority disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for; ARCH-DATA-001 is not risk-acceptable, so no risk acceptance is available and the snapshot cannot be approved as-is. Return-to-design/rework actions ASSIGN_DATA_OWNER and COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE are the required remediation; these are proposed actions, not completed remediation.

Applied DGF-decision-v8 security policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (version 1, age 0 days). Firing predicates: (1) internet_exposed = true, waf_present = true, waf_mode = "Detection" → SEC-WAF-002 (high, REWORK, ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION, Network Security, risk-acceptance-allowed); the HLD corroborates an ingress edge with "WAF + CDN" but the authoritative WAF_POLICY is UNAVAILABLE, so the snapshot's detection-only mode governs. (2) logs_to_siem = false → SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK, CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, SOC, risk-acceptance-allowed = False), corroborated by the authoritative SIEM connector state showing sentinel = false and no connectors. (3) key_rotation_days = 365 → SEC-KEY-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION, Cloud Security, risk-acceptance-allowed). Non-firing predicates: SEC-WAF-001 does not fire because waf_present = true; SEC-NET-001 does not fire because private_endpoints = true (Confidential classification notwithstanding), consistent with HLD "Private endpoints: True"; SEC-IAM-001 does not fire because mfa = "mandatory" (CONDITIONAL_ACCESS: "mfa": "mandatory", "policy_state": "enabled"); SEC-IAM-002 does not fire because shared_service_principal = false (IAM_EXPORT shows a single dedicated ManagedIdentity "workload-mi"); SEC-VULN-001 does not fire because critical_vulns_open = 0 (authoritative vulnerability state confirms critical_open 0, high_open 5); SEC-PENTEST-001 is phase-gated to build_acceptance and this gate is design, and pentest_status = "pass" regardless. Highest-priority disposition is REWORK. The standing mandate MANDATE-89255d0a...-BUILD-03-SECURITY-1 covers "all and only risk-acceptable findings", but SEC-LOG-001 is not risk-acceptable (risk_acceptance_allowed = False) and residual_risk_acceptance = false, so no conditional approval or risk acceptance is available for the snapshot as submitted. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no approval reference is required. Proposed actions ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION, CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM and IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION are remediation to be performed, not completed remediation. No upstream security specialist decision exists in this phase; the upstream architecture decision (REWORK, ARCH-DATA-001/ARCH-REV-001) is in a different gate and does not alter these security predicates.

Applied DGF-decision-v8 tech_readiness policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot (version 1, age 0 days). Firing predicates: (1) dr_required = true with dr_tested = false → TR-DR-001 (high, REWORK, RUN_DR_FAILOVER_TEST, SRE); corroborated by the authoritative FAILOVER_TEST record (result NOT_RUN, tested False, secondary region North Europe warm standby) and the HLD annotation "FAILOVER NOT TESTED". (2) critical_static_findings = 1 > 0 → TR-CODE-001 (high, REWORK, REMEDIATE_BUILD_FINDINGS, Engineering); corroborated by the authoritative CI_PIPELINE showing critical_static_findings 1. (3) runbook_status = "draft" ≠ "approved" → TR-OPS-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER, Operations); corroborated by the RUNBOOK document field "Runbook status | draft" while on_call_defined and handover_signed are true. Non-firing predicates verified against evidence: backup_enabled = true (authoritative BACKUP_JOBS enabled True, last_status Succeeded); restore_tested = true and measured_restore_hours 0.21 <= target_rto_hours 0.25, so TR-RESTORE-001 and TR-RTO-001 do not fire; measured_data_loss_minutes 1440 equals target_rpo_minutes 1440 — this is not "exceeding" the committed RPO, so TR-RPO-001 does not fire; load_test_pct_of_peak 125 >= 100, so TR-LOAD-001 does not fire (authoritative LOAD_TEST peak_test_pct 125); rollback_tested = true (ROLLBACK_TEST result PASS), so TR-ROLLBACK-001 does not fire; open_blockers = 0, so TR-BLOCKER-001 does not fire. Highest-priority disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so no approval reference is required. The standing mandate MANDATE-89255d0a...-BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1 covers "all and only risk-acceptable findings", but the driving findings TR-DR-001 and TR-CODE-001 are not risk-acceptable (risk_acceptance_allowed = False), so no conditional approval or risk acceptance is available for the snapshot as submitted. Proposed actions RUN_DR_FAILOVER_TEST, REMEDIATE_BUILD_FINDINGS and COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER are remediation to be performed, not completed remediation. Upstream decisions (IT REWORK, architecture REWORK, security REWORK) are in earlier gates/phases and do not alter these tech_readiness predicates.

Applied DGF-decision-v8 general policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot (version 1, age 0 days). Firing predicates: (1) strategic_alignment = \"weak\" → GEN-STRAT-001 (high, SUSPENSION, OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION, Sponsor). (2) budget_requested_eur 3000000 > budget_approved_eur 2550000 → GEN-BUDGET-001 (high, SUSPENSION, OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL, CFO / Sponsor), corroborated by the authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL record (requested 3000000, approved 2550000, status PARTIAL). (3) Upstream decisions contain no NO_GO and no SUSPENSION, but four REWORK decisions (IT, architecture, security, tech_readiness) → GEN-UPSTREAM-REWORK (high, REWORK, CLOSE_UPSTREAM_REWORK, Project Manager). Non-firing predicates: roi = 0.39 is not < 0.05, so GEN-BC-001 does not fire; phase is governance (not deployment_closure), so GEN-BENEFITS-001 does not fire. Highest-priority disposition is SUSPENSION, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization is required. The standing mandate MANDATE-89255d0a...-BUILD-05-GENERAL-1 covers \"all and only risk-acceptable findings\"; GEN-STRAT-001 and GEN-BUDGET-001 are risk-acceptable but the driving disposition is SUSPENSION, which requires authorization. Proposed actions OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION, OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL and CLOSE_UPSTREAM_REWORK are remediation to be performed, not completed remediation.
